runs.name: before-1
runs.method: Serial precompiled-PDF text/math, vectors, noisy RGB image; two warmups and seven samples/page/width. Qt cache cleared before each request; native PDF engine has no export content token. Publication includes raster/export/IPC/async Qt decode and 1ms polling, excludes widget painting. RSS sampled after publication, outside timing, excludes transient peaks/GPU. No TeX compilation in measured intervals.
